prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 87.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.4%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Story Screen Compact Overview']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Split Screen Live Pet Preview', 'Desktop Pet Quick Controls Overview Screen', 'Interactive Welcome Guide Flow', 'Account Persistence Notice', 'Desktop Controls Quick Reference Screen', 'Pet Care Basics Checklist', 'Pet Generation Guidance Screen', 'Waiting Screen Progress Stage Redesign', 'Pet Selection Two Column Comparison Layout', 'Split Layout Photo Upload Screen Redesign', 'Home Intro Desktop Mascot Welcome Redesign', 'Adoption Photo Preview Screen', 'Sign In Split Benefits Layout', 'Path Selection Split Overview']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Move Sign-In After Pet Selection', 'Interactive Controls Guide Screen', 'Interactive Pet Hatching Wait Flow', 'Path Selection Starter Benefits Banner', 'Spotlight Pet Selector Layout', 'Certificate Naming and Customization Flow', 'Path Choice Onboarding Time Estimate', 'Path Options Carousel Redesign', 'Pet Photo Verification Preview Screen', 'Adoption Certificate Stage Layout', 'Desktop Pet Intro Welcome Flow', 'Photo Upload Best Practices Hint', 'Adoption Certificate Mascot Stage', 'Fast Track Sign In Options', 'Reorder Photo Upload Before Selection', 'Post-Onboarding Control Overview Flow', 'Story-Driven Path Selection Layout', 'Pet Friend Selection Playful Choice Flow', 'Photo Upload Checklist Redesign', 'Desktop Placement Instructions Screen', 'Account Sync Security Redesign', 'Sign In Account Recovery Prompt Screen', 'Pet Personality Selection Stage Flow', 'Adoption Certificate Starter Bonus Badge', 'Custom Photo Quality Guidance Hint', 'Grid Choice Path Redesign', 'Sign In Focused Card Layout Redesign', 'Starter Companion Perk Badge', 'Sign In Security Assurance Layout']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose path redesign, finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, sign-in hint, and sign-in redesign changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high, though round 11 was underpredicted.
Negative predictions were too low, as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Account Persistence Warning Hint
candidates.change: Display a explicit hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to use their original authentication method so pets are not reset.
candidates.why: Support logs show 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, suggesting users unintentionally create duplicate accounts.

sign_in.hint: Signing in with a different method creates a new account and won't restore previous pets.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Checklist Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the photo upload screen into a checklist layout with a visual progress bar to ensure clear custom pet image submissions.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion to 60.9% (89s median), and 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking incorrect.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Background Notification
candidates.change: Enable optional ready notifications and a delayed tip carousel on the waiting screen during pet generation.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long median time of 201s (mean 2336s), and users report app stalls or confusion about pet appearance.

candidates.title: Story Screen Full Bleed Experience
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story screen into a full-bleed layout with playful mascot imagery and clear introductory narrative text.
candidates.why: The initial path selection stage has a long mean duration of 514s, indicating initial hesitation or lack of context.

intro_story.text: Begin your journey with your new interactive desktop companion.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Interactive Cards
candidates.change: Switch the friend selection step to a grid layout using highlighted choice card components.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest friction drop-off in the onboarding funnel, falling from 72.9% to 60.9%.

candidates.title: Sign In Centered Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen to a centered layout with clear button actions to prevent screen stall confusion.
candidates.why: Support tickets noted sign-in screens stalling or failing to load, causing 27.1% drop-off at this step.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet

candidates.title: Home Intro Mascot Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a stage layout with a mascot welcome component and clear next action button.
candidates.why: The finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with 395s median time, and support receives tickets regarding pet desktop placement confusion.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Desktop

candidates.title: Path Selection Card Progress Layout
candidates.change: Reformat the choose path screen to a card layout with active step counters and time estimates.
candidates.why: Path selection takes a mean of 514s; providing structured step counts helps set clear completion expectations.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Seal Layout
candidates.change: Transform the adoption certificate screen to a story scroll layout featuring an official seal badge component.
candidates.why: Reinforcing emotional attachment at the adoption stage can reduce drop-off before reaching the desktop home step.

candidates.title: Waiting Generation Progress Bar
candidates.change: Update the waiting screen to a checklist layout with an embedded progress indicator component.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high mean time (2336s) and causes user confusion regarding whether pet generation is active.
